lines.scene: INT. STRIP CLUB - CHAMPAGNE ROOM - NIGHT

lines.scene: EXT. STRIP CLUB - PARKING LOT - DAY
lines.dialogue: ‘Cause like... It’s like... Never mind. Jesus! Maybe now I gotta, like, leave town or change my identity or something. Guy’s blackmailing me. He’s got, like a criminal mind, yo.

lines.dialogue: No, I need it today. Now.

lines.dialogue: You’re telling me you can get me an RV. For 1400. At six in the morning.
Right on. So do I need to sign something or something?
Uh, yeah, right. Like you DON’T KNOW.
Like you didn’t make some deal BEHIND MY BACK!
Whatever, man. You owe me that money!
Trust you?! Trust you? That- that’s a good one, yeah. Yeah, that’s what I’m gonna do.
‘Cause I never said I wouldn’t cook it! ‘Cause it ain’t yours, it’s OURS! Plural, bitch!
Alls I know is I got HALF the money I’m DUE and you got the rest!
Y’know what? Escalate this. My meth, my money!
I will be a one-man glass factory. I’ll rock that RV 24/7..!!!
Oh, I’m gonna say jack. I’m gonna say plenty.
What do you mean?
To hell with this. I’m outta here.
You’re late.
That’s charity, is what that is. I do all the work, he sits around on his fat ass judging people --
You’re damn right it belongs to me.
What the hell’s that s’posed to mean?
What are you talking about?
You’re telling me you’re cooking again? --
What in the hell just happened? You’re my lawyer, not HIS! --
You think this’ll stop me from cooking?!
Just try and stop me, bitch! --

lines.scene: INT. JESSE’S HOUSE - LIVING ROOM - DAY
lines.dialogue: We sell it safe. Alright? We sell it smart. We don’t get greedy, like before.

lines.dialogue: Hey. It will be. Step One, we build inventory. Badger, go see Clovis. Get the RV in shape. Tune up, oil change, brake lights and whatnot. Cops always pull you over brake lights. Not us. Cautious.

lines.scene: INT. JESSE’S HOUSE - LIVING ROOM - DAY

Good? Alright

lines.dialogue: What? Mr. White..?
No... listen to me, you get that address... ... Badger, I don’t care how, you find out where he’s taking it!
The hell you think you’re DOING?! Huh?! --
This is mine just as much as yours! You don’t get to just -- just --
What?
What?
Who’s here? --
What?
HOW COULD YOU HAVE KNOWN THEY WERE THERE BEFORE YOU TOOK OFF THE TAPE?!
THIS IS MY OWN PRIVATE DOMICILE AND I WILL NOT BE HARASSED! BITCH!
I say -- I say we just ram him, alright? We, uh we, we start her up, just ram the shit out of his truck... and make our escape! Right?!
Yeah, he’d, uh... he’d shoot me in the head. Yeah, he’d shoot me in the head. So what do we DO, man?! Huh?! What do we... what..? Please tell me you got something.
Yo, I thought I was gonna see some, like, vaginas.
Uh, seriously? Not even close.
Not like any vagina I ever saw. This chick have medical issues?
Any other doors here we can check out? Like, real ones, or...?
Y’know, I-I-I don’t get it. Why would anyone paint a picture of a door? Over and over again, like dozens of times?
Uh, yeah. It was.
And that’s not psycho to you.
Whoa. No...
Okay, fine. I guess the cow skull pictures were cool, but... a DOOR? I will say it again. A door. Zzzzzzzzzzzzzzz...
Okay, so... the universe took her to a door. She got all obsessed with it and just had to paint it twenty times until it was perfect.
Yeah? Well, I mean... Some things.
You can’t admit just for once that I’m right?! C’mon. That O’Keeffe lady kept trying over and over until that stupid door was perfect.
What the hell, man?
What, I can’t work a scale now?
This is bullshit. Just say it. Just say the words. You think I’m stealing?!
Hey. ‘Sup. My name’s Jesse.
I just, uh, wanted to give you a heads up. It’s gonna get a little slower smuggling product with, uh, Grandpa Anus watching every move I make. Don’t worry. I’ll keep it flowing.
So, uh... how’zit selling? Mad volume?
What do you mean? How much have you sold?
One teenth?! That’s it? To who?
I’m out risking my ass to get product for you two, and you’re too pussy to sell?! You’re pathetic. Y’know what? I want it back. All of it. I’ll sell it myself!
I will show you exactly how easy it is...
Oh, hey. Sorry...
Andrea, right?
Hey. Um, my name’s Jesse, and, uh... I don’t really want to be here either. Oh, uh... Sorry...
Or somethin’? What do you mean?
Yeah. I’ve heard it... over and over and over again. Y’know, don’t you think it’s ridiculous that society says beer is okay, and a little hit of something... sweet is wrong?
I mean, mhat’s the point of shutting yourself off completely from something that... lifts you off the ground? I spend so much energy fighting the urge not to use, and I feel like crap ‘cause of it...
What?

The thing is... not to get caught. You ever try that blue stuff that’s going around? Just a little gas in the tank and... suddenly everything is interesting. Man. I wish I could make that feeling last.
What if I could get some?
So... you, uh, you have a kid, huh?
‘Sup? Brock, huh. That’s a cool name. Here. Give it up...
What? Yeah, yeah... He’s cool.
Please, just..? Dumbass.
Do what?
What are you two even doing here? --
You can’t get your nut up to sell, what’s the point of even coming?
Whatever. Later.
Hey, you know what? I have magical powers. You wanna see? Ready?
It is real. Alright, D’you want to see something that’s real? Look at this. Watch this. Ready?
You like that? That’s science and stuff, makes it do that.
It’s okay... It’s okay. Wanna see it again?
Firecrackers? Um, you know, I have any firecrackers on me. Who does a trick with firecrackers?
Tomás does tricks with firecrackers, huh. Who’s Tomás?
Yeah?
Can I have your chip? I’m gonna steal your chip.
Yeah. Thanks. What time is it?
What?
... what?
Wait, whoa... what? You said the kid is coming home...
And you seriously wanna get high?!
Yeah. That was before I found out you got a kid. What kind of mother are you?
You heard me. What kinda mom gets wasted with a little kid to take care of?
Look, I...
Sorry. I-I just... Look, I’ll-I’ll get outta here if you want.
It’s not what I want. Look... I was outta line... talkin’ about that stuff.
You’re right. I don’t know what you’ve been through... You can tell me if you want.
Who’d he say he killed?
Off of Central. Like, over by the train tracks..? When was this?
What else did he tell you?
Right.
What was that?
Hey. TOMÁS Wassup?
You, uh, you Tomás? I heard you were the man. TOMÁS Yeah? What you want?
Um, crystal. You think you could hook me up? TOMÁS Three hundred.
For a teenth? Shit, c’mon, yo. TOMÁS Three hundred.
Hey, ‘sup.
Hey! Yo!
